bot.list.doc: Every bot, with its state and settings.

bot.get.doc: One bot, with its state and settings.

bot.setUserLayer.doc: Sets or clears fields of a bot's user layer; a change to its instructions applies at the next compaction.

bots.pause.doc: The core switch that pauses every bot and routine at once (§9.2).

session.list.doc: Every session: bots' conversations, side threads, background agents and coding sessions (`ListAgents`).

session.attach.doc: Follows a session live: replays events after `since`, then streams them with the inherited `event` notification.

session.history.doc: A page of a session's past events, newest last; sealed card fields never reach a plugin (§5.4).

session.send.doc: The user's message: it interrupts a bot's main conversation at once; it needs a live connection to the computer running the bot (`BOT_ASLEEP`).

session.post.doc: A plugin adds a note, or sends a bot a message that folds in; a turn it starts is the plugin's (§5.4).

session.interrupt.doc: Stops the current step; background tasks keep running (§6.4).

session.stop.doc: Stops a side thread, a background agent or a coding session (`TaskStop`).

session.answer.doc: Answers an `AskUserQuestion`, which plugins may read and show in any form (§5.5).

session.setModel.doc: Switches an agent's or coding session's model mid-session; a bot's model is its user layer (§6.3).

session.compact.doc: Compacts now, so new instructions apply at once at the cost of a cache miss (§5.6).

memory.list.doc: A bot's memory files: `MEMORY.md` and the files it links to (§6.5).

routine.runNow.doc: Runs a routine now, in a side thread on its computer.

archive.list.doc: Old Winter sessions, newest first, for the archive view (§14.1).

archive.history.doc: An old Winter session's transcript, read-only; it never becomes a bot's history.

bot_changed.doc: A bot's settings or state changed.

bot_removed.doc: A bot's plugin was removed; its memory and transcript stay under its id (§6.1).

session_changed.doc: A session started, changed state or ended.

routines_changed.doc: The routine list changed; clients re-read `routine.list`.

agent_message.doc: A background agent's message to its bot.

routine_result.doc: A routine run's result in the main conversation.

note.doc: A labelled note in the conversation.

plugin_message.doc: A plugin's message to the bot; the turn it starts is the plugin's.
